Taylor Mason Capital — Q3 2026 Letter to Shareholders (published October 21, 2026)

Assets under management ended the quarter at $38.4 billion, down 3% from $39.6 billion at the end of Q2.
Net outflows were $0.9 billion, concentrated in our long/short equity funds; our systematic funds took in new money for a fourth straight quarter.
Fee-related earnings were $118 million for the quarter.
We paused our share buyback during the quarter to keep balance-sheet flexibility.
We will publish our Q4 investor letter on November 16, 2026.

"Performance in a hard tape was solid. Flows will follow performance, as they always have." — Taylor Mason, founder and chief executive
